questions.question: The speaker stresses the importance to Clifton Bird Park of

analyses.content: 录音中提到很多野生物种在野外存活的数量已经不多了（对应濒危 endangered），因此公园的一项重要工作就是帮助它们增加数量。
你可能会听到最后一句的“native species”就想选C，但录音真正强调的是“帮助数量稀少的鸟类繁殖”这个重要任务，而不是单纯强调它们在当地很常见。

I think people love coming to see so many different types of birds in a beautiful environment. For some species that we have here, there aren't many still alive in the wild, so a big part of our job is to make sure we help their numbers increase. All the birds are native species.

questions.question: People who volunteer to help with gardening at the park

analyses.content: 录音明确提出，公园对志愿者最少的出勤要求是“每四周来一天（one day every four weeks）”，这完美对应了选项B的“每月至少一次”。
你可能会听到“Saturdays and Sundays”就想选A，或者听到“summer”想选C，但录音明确说周末已经有很多人了，而且公园全年（all year round）都需要打理，直接排除了干扰。

Obviously, summer is the time when we have most visitors, but the park needs looking after all year round. If you want to help, you can choose which day, although we do already have plenty of volunteers working Saturdays and Sundays. But one day every four weeks is the minimum commitment that we ask for.

questions.question: According to the speaker, who would be the ideal gardening volunteer?

analyses.content: 录音强调他们更需要的是那种“无论下雨还是酷暑（raining or baking hot）”都能按时出现的灵活志愿者，对应选项B的“愿意在任何天气下工作”。
你可能听到“expert knowledge”就急着选C，或者听到“teamwork”觉得跟A对立，但讲话人马上用了“but”转折，告诉你他们最看重的是不惧天气的灵活性。

So who's the ideal volunteer for gardening work? If you have expert knowledge about flowers and trees, great, but we're looking more for people who are flexible and turn up no matter whether it's raining or baking hot. That's what'll make you the best person for the job. It's all teamwork, so you'll have plenty of support.

questions.question: Volunteer guides will mainly be working with

analyses.content: 录音直接点明志愿向导主要负责的对象是“外国旅游团（foreign tour group）”，这也就是选项A中的国际游客。
你可能会在后面听到当地居民（Clifton residents）或者学校班级（classes），但录音接着补充了当地人自己认识路，而学生归公园正式员工管，别被干扰词骗了。

What about volunteer guides? A guide's role is to point out the birds and talk about the conservation program. In general, it's people in a foreign tour group that you're responsible for. The Clifton residents who come to the park usually know their way around. We get a few teachers bringing in classes, but they're the park officer's responsibility.

questions.question: What is still required for the Maintenance Day at the bird park?

analyses.content: 录音中呼吁如果有人能“开车接送其他志愿者（drive some other volunteers）”请告诉她，因为那边需要帮助，这意味着目前依然需要交通工具（transport）。
选项A的食物（refreshments）和选项C的工具（spades, drills等）录音里确实都提到了，但这俩都是公园已经“准备提供（provide/offering）”的，唯独交通是仍然“需要（need help there）”的。

The last thing to mention is the park's maintenance day, which is coming up soon. We're hoping to get as many volunteers as possible to come and help tidy things up. If anyone is able to drive some other volunteers to the event, please let me know because we need help there. The park officers will provide you with spades and drills and hammers, all of that stuff, and they'll be offering you some refreshments too. So it should be a good day out.
录音提示在Clifton Lane的南边有一个停车场，停车场下面有两个大小相似的池塘，而木桥就在这两个池塘中间（between those two ponds），对应位置F。
做地图题跟丢起点的同学注意了，你必须要先找到大门“main gate”和“Clifton Lane”，并准确反应出“southern side（南侧即下方）”，死死盯住“两个池塘中间”这个终极定位。

Firstly, the wooden bridge. I'll explain where that is. You can see Clifton Lane and the main gate into the park. On the southern side of Clifton Lane is one of our car parks, and below that there are two similar-sized ponds. The wooden bridge runs between those two ponds. We just need to make it a bit stronger.
录音先给出了大方向是地图的“东南角（southeast corner）”，接着精准定位在“大池塘的南边（south side of the larger pond）”且在小路尽头，直接锁定字母H。
你可能会在G和H之间犹豫，但录音不仅强调了“larger pond（大池塘）”，还说了在池塘“南边（south side）”，抓牢这两个限定词就不会选错。

Some volunteers will be doing a bit of painting at the observation tower. The tower's in the southeast corner of the map. You see there are two different sized ponds there. The tower's on the south side of the larger pond at the end of the path. We'll need about three people to help out.
录音引导你先看地图北边的停车场，接着明确指出游客小屋在“树林（woods）”和左侧的“火车站（railway station）”之间，对应字母C。
如果你没有看清左上角“railway station”这个标志建筑物，或是漏听了“between（在...之间）”，在这个区域就很容易看花眼。

We need to replace the windows on the visitor cabins. So on the map you can see our car park on the north side of Clifton Lane. There's the woods and on the left-hand side of the map, the railway line. The visitors cabins are marked there between the woods and the railway station.
录音让你沿着野餐区（picnic area）和池塘中间的那条小路一直走到底，明确提示目标在“那个池塘的右边（right of that pond）”，对应字母E。
这条行进路线很长，如果你没有坚持听到“走到底（all the way to the end）”可能会半路下车选了D，最后那句“池塘的右边”是锁定E的防错保险。

You'll also be repairing some nesting boxes. See the picnic area? The path you want is between there and the big pond. Follow it round all the way to the end. So as we're looking at the map now, the nesting boxes are on the right of that pond.
录音将视线拉到地图最上方靠近铁路的小池塘，并指出目标和“树林在同一侧（same side as the woods）”，对应字母B。
这里A和B紧挨着非常容易选错，但录音最后补了一刀“不是公园最顶端那个点（not the place marked at the tip）”，这句话就是专门用来帮你排除A的。

Finally, the boat sheds. Towards the top of the map, you've got that smallish pond quite near the railway line, and there are two places marked up there. The boat sheds are on the same side of the pond as the woods, not the place marked at the tip of the park. What we want you to do...
